# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects if a target is under the influence of a charm or other mind control
affect (generally speaking, that would include any spell with a sub-type of
“m”). The mind control spell may resist detection by making an RR at the level
of the caster of the charm spell (or the level of the charm spell).
@@ 2
The target of this spell will take no offensive action, and will fight only in
selfdefence.
@@ 3
Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him
(e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).
@@ 4
Causes the target to be affected by any one desired emotion chosen at time of
casting. Possible emotions include hate, love, sadness, anger, fear, etc. The
caster may choose the object of the induced emotion.
@@ 5
Caster can cause the target to doubt the truth of one belief or fact chosen by
the caster for the duration of this spell. The target may regain his belief
prematurely if he is presented with irrefutable evidence of the doubted
belief’s truth or persuaded of its veracity.
@@ 6
The target must obey the caster for the duration of this spell, as specified
in Suggestion I.
@@ 7
Caster can cause the target to believe, with complete certainty, an idea,
reasoning, or “fact” implanted by the caster for the duration of this spell.
The target may lose this belief prematurely if he is presented with
irrefutable evidence of the falsehood of the belief or persuaded of its
falsehood.
@@ 8
As Calm I, except affects 3 targets.
@@ 9
As Suggestion I, except affects 3 targets and the range is 20'.
@@ 10
As Emotion I, except affects 3 targets.
@@ 11
As Obedience I, except affects 2 targets.
@@ 12
As Calm I, except affects 5 targets.
@@ 13
As Suggestion I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 30'.
@@ 14
As Emotion I, except affects 5 targets.
@@ 15
As Obedience I, except affects 3 targets and the range is 20'.
@@ 16
As Calm I, except affects 10 targets.
@@ 17
As Suggestion I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 50'.
@@ 18
As Emotion I, except affects 10 targets.
@@ 19
As Obedience I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 30'.
@@ 20
As Calm I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.
@@ 25
As Suggestion I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster and the range
is 100'.
@@ 30
As Emotion I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.
@@ 50
As Obedience I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster and the range
is 100'.
